description: Return private.law's reviewed structured answer to a concrete question about one country, residence or citizenship programme, tax regime, bank or legal form — the statement, conditions and verbatim quotations from official sources with URLs and dates. Ask in natural language (the place must be named), or pass exact codes from answer_objects. When the question is not matched with confidence, found=false and candidates suggest known questions to clarify. Candidates are metadata only, carry no citation URL and do not establish that an answer is currently available. Pass object alone to list its known question topics. reason distinguishes invalid input, unknown public-catalog identities, a low-confidence match and no currently available reviewed answer; it never determines that no legal rule exists.

object.description: Object code or name (optional); the question is then matched against that object only.

question.description: A natural-language question naming the place, programme, bank or form.

name: answer_lookup

exceptionOfRef.description: Exact native parent answer reference; null when absent. No parent is inferred.

checked.description: Actual native date the quotation was checked in the current stored snapshot; not proof of current law.

evidenceNote.description: Full native explanation of the limited role of this source.

evidenceRole.description: Identity-only required evidence; not proof of the answer tariff or current client eligibility.

language.description: Language recorded for the native quotation.

quote.description: Verbatim text of the official source.

quoteTranslation.description: Exact translation supplied by the native source record; null when absent.

sourceClass.description: Normal source classification from the admitted B item.

sourceDate.description: The native source document date; null when unknown. Separate from quotation verification.

sourceKind.description: Native source kind; null when withheld from the public projection.

sourceQualification.description: Source qualification from the admitted B item, when present.

translationLanguage.description: Language of the exact quotation translation; null when absent.

verificationFingerprint.description: Exact B source snapshot and quotation fingerprint; not current-law proof.

materialVersion.description: Content-addressed version of this complete native cell, including all qualifications and source evidence; independent of the request revision.

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

revision.description: Request/projection revision; distinct from cell.materialVersion and provenance.version.

title: Look up a reviewed answer with its official source
